newsitem.title: FINLAND: OKO SEES NO IMPACT FROM BREAKAWAY BANKS.
newsitem.headline: OKO SEES NO IMPACT FROM BREAKAWAY BANKS.

text.p: Finnish cooperative banking group OKOBANK said on Wednesday the breakaway of a number of banks from the group would have no impact on its result this year and no significant impact in the future.
"Also in the years to come, the weakening effect will not be significant," OKOBANK said in a statement.

"With the information available today, no precise estimate (of the impact) can be given, because the final number of banks remaining outside (the group) and the length of the transition period are not yet known," OKOBANK said.

On April 18, the chairman of the Finnish cooperative banking group Osuuspankkikeskus-OPK said 49 of the group's former members had decided to opt out of the new group, while over 200 member banks had decided to join.
